decisions.reason: ‘Danh hiệu’ conveys the UI label 称号 accurately and naturally.
Generic 赛马娘 must use the project world/species term ‘Mã Nương’, not the forbidden ‘Uma Musume’ form.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded community term common.world.umamusume requires Mã Nương for generic 赛马娘.

decisions.reason: ‘Phiên bản ứng dụng’ is an accurate natural rendering of 应用版本.
Meaning and required newline structure are preserved: the OS version currently in use.
‘Tên thiết bị đang sử dụng’ accurately conveys 您使用的设备名.
‘Điều khoản sử dụng’ is the standard and accurate rendering of 使用条款.
In this settings/legal UI context, ‘Thông tin bản quyền’ is a natural player-facing rendering of 权利标记.
‘Lv Thức tỉnh’ preserves the awakening-level label accurately and compactly.
The current text exactly matches the required player-facing Trainer terminology.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded community term common.trainer requires ‘Trainer’ and forbids ‘Huấn luyện viên’.

decisions.reason: In the support/inquiry UI context, 查询 is appropriately localized as ‘Liên hệ’.
The translation accurately communicates that the contact/inquiry form will open and asks for confirmation.
Meaning, three-line structure, and color tag are preserved correctly in the support-form explanation.
‘Bí mật’ directly and naturally translates 秘密.
‘Xác nhận phát cốt truyện’ accurately represents the story-playback confirmation label.
‘Điều kiện mở khóa’ is the standard, accurate rendering of 解锁条件.
